description: Omits omit out of every group pseudo-wavecycles, replacing them with silence. Because the omitted wavecycles are replaced (not removed), the overall duration does not change: duration model static, SAMPLE-EXACT across all probe runs (88200/44100 frames preserved on 2 s and 1 s tone and noise inputs, omit/group 2/5, 4/5, 10/16, 1/2, and a breakpointed omit). Mono input only.
musical_use: Rough texturing with no loss of duration: the sound keeps its outline, rhythm and gesture while its surface is eaten away. Small proportions (1-2 cycles out of 5 or more) lay a granular, gritty film over the sound; large proportions (most of the group silenced) turn it into a hard-edged sputter, like a failing connection. Because omit takes a breakpoint file, the erosion can be automated - e.g. ramp omit from 1 toward group-1 to dissolve a sustained sound into crackle over its length (keep every breakpoint value below group). A gentler alternative to the modulatory waveset distortions when you want grain rather than pitch artefacts.

omit.description: Number of wavecycles silenced out of each group (CDP-enforced range 1-32767: 0 refused with 'Parameter[1] Value (0.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 32767.000000)'). Must always be less than group, enforced at runtime: 'ERROR: A > or = B: can't proceed.' (applies to every breakpoint value too). Breakpoint-capable, banner-confirmed ('A may vary over time'): a 1-to-7 envelope against group 8 exits 0, stays sample-exact in length and differs from both endpoint scalar renders.

group.description: Size of the wavecycle group out of which omit cycles are silenced (CDP-enforced range 2-32768: 'Parameter[2] Value (40000.000000) out of range (2.000000 to 32768.000000)'). The proportion omit/group sets the erosion depth; the group size itself sets the alternation rate between sound and silence (small groups flicker fast, large groups gate slowly). Scalar only - a breakpoint file is refused.

examples.description: Light granular film: silence 2 cycles in every 5.
examples.expected_use: Gritty surface over an intact gesture; output duration is sample-exact to the input.

examples.description: Progressive dissolution: erode from 1 to 7 cycles out of every 8 across the file.
examples.expected_use: The sound crumbles into sputter as it proceeds; duration unchanged.

known_issues: omit must stay below group at all times or CDP aborts at runtime with 'ERROR: A > or = B: can't proceed.' - this also applies to every value in a breakpointed omit; the schema cannot enforce the cross-parameter constraint, so out-of-order values fail at run time, not validation time.
group's breakpoint refusal: 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 2 [b3_b.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'

afta8/SoundThread advisory ranges (omit 1-63, group 2-64) are a small subset of the CDP-enforced 1-32767 / 2-32768; very large groups need correspondingly long files worth of wavecycles to have any effect.
Mono only: stereo refused with 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (exit 255).
